plain: Members pay $40 in yearly dues.
legal: Each Member shall pay annual dues of $40.

plain: Dues are due by January 31.
legal: Annual dues shall be paid on or before January 31.

plain: Members who haven't paid can't vote.
legal: Members whose dues remain unpaid shall not be entitled to vote.

plain: The committee meets every month.
legal: The Committee shall meet on a monthly basis.

plain: A meeting needs at least half the committee present to make decisions.
legal: The quorum for any meeting of the Committee shall be one half of its members.

plain: Decisions are made by majority vote.
legal: All decisions shall be made by a simple majority of votes cast.

plain: If there's a tie, the chair has the deciding vote.
legal: In the event of an equality of votes, the Chair shall have a casting vote.

plain: Officers are elected for 2-year terms.
legal: Officers shall be elected for a term of two (2) years.

plain: Nobody can serve more than 3 terms in a row.
legal: No person shall serve more than three (3) consecutive terms.

plain: The treasurer must present the accounts at the annual meeting.
legal: The Treasurer shall present the accounts at the annual general meeting.

plain: Spending over $500 needs committee approval.
legal: Any expenditure exceeding $500 shall require the approval of the Committee.

plain: Any member can propose a change to these rules.
legal: Any Member may propose an amendment to these Rules.

plain: Rule changes need a two-thirds majority at the annual meeting.
legal: Any amendment to these Rules shall require a two-thirds majority of the votes cast at the annual general meeting.

plain: Members can be expelled for serious misconduct.
legal: A Member may be expelled for serious misconduct.

plain: A member facing expulsion has the right to be heard first.
legal: A Member subject to expulsion proceedings shall be entitled to be heard before any decision is made.

plain: Kids under 12 must be with an adult at the pool.
legal: Children under the age of twelve (12) shall be accompanied by an adult at the pool.

plain: Shower before entering the pool.
legal: All users shall shower before entering the pool.

plain: No running on the pool deck.
legal: Running on the pool deck is prohibited.

plain: The community garden plots are assigned for one season.
legal: Community garden plots shall be allocated for a single growing season.

plain: Plots left untended for 4 weeks may be reassigned.
legal: Any plot left untended for four (4) weeks may be reallocated.

plain: Only organic fertilizers are allowed in the garden.
legal: Only organic fertilizers shall be used in the Garden.

plain: Tools must be returned to the shed after use.
legal: All tools shall be returned to the shed after use.

plain: Dogs must be on a leash in the park.
legal: Dogs shall be kept on a leash at all times within the Park.

plain: Owners must pick up after their dogs.
legal: Dog owners shall remove their dogs' waste.

plain: The playground is for children aged 2 to 12.
legal: The playground is intended for children between the ages of two (2) and twelve (12).

plain: Students must arrive by 8:30 am.
legal: Students shall arrive at school no later than 8:30 am.

plain: Phones must be switched off during lessons.
legal: Mobile telephones shall be switched off during lessons.

plain: Homework handed in late loses 10% per day.
legal: A penalty of 10% per day shall apply to homework submitted after the deadline.

plain: Students who miss an exam need a medical certificate to resit it.
legal: A student who misses an examination shall provide a medical certificate in order to be eligible to resit it.

plain: Plagiarism will result in a zero for the assignment.
legal: Any assignment found to contain plagiarism shall receive a mark of zero.

plain: Library books can be borrowed for 3 weeks.
legal: Library books may be borrowed for a period of three (3) weeks.

plain: Late returns cost 25 cents a day.
legal: A fine of 25 cents per day shall be charged for late returns.

plain: Reference books can't leave the library.
legal: Reference books shall not be removed from the Library.

plain: Food and drink aren't allowed in the reading room.
legal: Food and beverages are not permitted in the reading room.

plain: The club's equipment may only be used by members who've done the safety course.
legal: The Club's equipment shall be used only by Members who have completed the safety course.

plain: Climbers must always use a partner check before climbing.
legal: Climbers shall carry out a partner check prior to each climb.

plain: The hall can be rented for private events at $200 per evening.
legal: The Hall may be hired for private events at a rate of $200 per evening.

plain: Renters must leave the hall by midnight.
legal: Hirers shall vacate the Hall no later than midnight.

plain: The renter is responsible for any damage to the hall.
legal: The Hirer shall be liable for any damage caused to the Hall.

plain: Decorations can't be attached to the walls with nails.
legal: Decorations shall not be affixed to the walls by means of nails.

plain: The team captain is chosen by the players.
legal: The Team Captain shall be elected by the players.

plain: Players who miss 3 practices in a row may be dropped from the next game.
legal: Any player who misses three (3) consecutive practices may be excluded from the following match.

plain: Respect the referee's decisions.
legal: All participants shall respect the decisions of the referee.

plain: Volunteers must be at least 16 years old.
legal: Volunteers shall be at least sixteen (16) years of age.

plain: Volunteers under 18 need a parent's signed consent.
legal: Volunteers under the age of eighteen (18) shall provide the signed consent of a parent or guardian.

plain: Donations are used only for the shelter's animals.
legal: All donations shall be used exclusively for the care of the Shelter's animals.

plain: Adopters must agree to a home visit.
legal: Prospective adopters shall consent to a home visit.

plain: If you can't keep the pet, return it to the shelter.
legal: If the adopter is unable to keep the animal, the adopter shall return it to the Shelter.

plain: The residents' association represents all owners in the building.
legal: The Residents' Association shall represent all owners within the Building.

plain: Each apartment gets one vote.
legal: Each apartment shall be entitled to one (1) vote.

plain: Renovation work is only allowed between 9 am and 5 pm on weekdays.
legal: Renovation works shall be permitted only between 9 am and 5 pm on weekdays.

plain: Common areas must be kept free of personal items.
legal: Common areas shall be kept clear of personal belongings.

plain: Moving in or out requires booking the service elevator.
legal: Residents shall reserve the service elevator for any move into or out of the Building.

plain: Satellite dishes may not be installed on the front of the building.
legal: Satellite dishes shall not be installed on the front facade of the Building.

plain: The annual meeting must be held before the end of March.
legal: The annual general meeting shall be held before the end of March.

plain: Members will get at least 21 days' notice of the annual meeting.
legal: Members shall receive not less than twenty-one (21) days' notice of the annual general meeting.

plain: Minutes of each meeting will be shared with all members.
legal: The minutes of each meeting shall be circulated to all Members.

plain: The club can be dissolved only by a vote of three quarters of the members.
legal: The Club may be dissolved only by a resolution passed by three quarters of the Members.

plain: If the club is dissolved, any leftover money goes to a local charity.
legal: Upon the dissolution of the Club, any remaining funds shall be donated to a local charity.

plain: These rules take effect immediately after they are adopted.
legal: These Rules shall take effect immediately upon their adoption.
